title: COFFE Phone-Call Test
summary: With Herzfeld Medical Center: a simulated phone that tests a patient's ability to communicate and make decisions on their own in daily life.
description:
As part of **COFFE**, a cognitive test for management skills and independence, we developed a module that simulates a smartphone in collaboration with **Herzfeld Medical Center**.

The test assesses how well a patient handles independent communication and decision-making in everyday life, in two scenarios:

1. **Find and call a contact** — open the contacts app or the dialer, find the requested person, and call them.
2. **Dial a number** — from a list of numbers (family doctor, dentist, clinics and more), dial the requested one using the keypad.

The app is entering **Phase 1 clinical trials**, which will evaluate its effectiveness and reliability under controlled conditions. It runs as a module of [DMT – Proms++](/projects/dmt-proms).
